original_text.raw_value: To a stirred solution of allylamine 1a (1.01 g, 5.0 mmol) in methanol (25 mL) was added allenone 2a (865 mg, 6.0 mmol). The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 12 h and concentrated under reduced pressure to remove the methanol. The residue was diluted with dichloromethane (50 mL, containing 1.0% (v/v) water), and silica gel (12.5 g) was added. The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 12 h and then filtered, and the silica gel was washed with dichloromethane (3 × 25 mL). The combined filtrates were concentrated under reduced pressure, and the residue was purified by silica gel chromatography (petroleum ether:ethyl acetate = 10:1) to give compound 4a as a yellow solid (1.27 g, 87%).
